summary: Configure agent skills and MCP servers for AI coding assistants to scaffold projects, modify components, answer documentation questions, and generate themes.
Create and style area, bar, column, line, pie, scatter, polar, radial, stock, Sankey, treemap, and other charts with axes, series, legends, and data binding.
Configure chart axes, annotations, data aggregation and filtering, tooltips, legends, selections, highlights, markers, trendlines, navigation, and performance.
Covers how Dashboard Tile analyzes data sources, selects visualization types, supports module setup, and presents gauge, pie chart, and geographic map examples
Covers buttons, chips, form inputs, selection controls, progress indicators, date and color entry, ratings, dropdowns, icons, QR codes, highlighting, and virtualized lists.
Covers Combo data binding, filtering and grouping, single or multiple selection, validation, focus, dropdown behavior, styling, accessibility, and templates.
Create, load, and save Excel workbooks; configure worksheets, cells, tables, charts, sparklines, formulas, styles, filtering, sorting, and protection.
Configure bullet graphs and linear or radial gauges with ranges, scales, tick marks, labels, backings, needles, highlights, animation, and optical scaling.
Covers app setup, package installation, licensing, localization, client and server components, upgrades, changelogs, accessibility, and right-to-left layouts
Use CLI and Theming MCP in one chat workflow to scaffold an app, add features, ask documentation questions, and apply a custom theme.
Install the CLI to scaffold projects, choose templates and themes, add component views, run apps, and configure AI agents through MCP.
Create simple and contact-style lists with headers, slotted content, avatars, and actions, plus hierarchical trees with expansion, selection, and keyboard navigation

Install and use a lightweight data grid with configurable columns, cell and header templates, data binding, filtering, sorting, and custom themes.

Configure multidimensional analysis with dimensions, aggregations, filters, date hierarchies, state persistence, sorting, resizing, compact mode, and theming.
Load and save workbooks, edit and navigate worksheets, manage active cells and panes, add charts and hyperlinks, use clipboard, formatting, validation, protection, and zoom
Covers hierarchical data, editing, filtering, sorting, paging, selection, pinning, resizing, exporting, virtualization, summaries, theming, and state persistence.
Build chat experiences with messages, attachments, and quick replies; add ripples and tooltips; configure sliders and ZoomSlider navigation; create query builders
Organize accessible content with expandable panels, tabs, cards, carousels, steppers, resizable split panes, tile managers, avatars, breadcrumbs, and dividers.
Define Dock Manager layouts with split, tab group, document host, and floating panes; update panes, embed iframe content, and customize docking, navigation, styling
Display geographic points, lines, polygons, bubbles, symbols, density, contours, and interpolated areas with data binding, styling, tooltips, scales, and viewport controls.
Covers geographic maps, imagery backgrounds, CSV/JSON/model/shapefile binding, symbols and shapes, overlays, navigation, heat maps, and styling utilities.
Covers Toolbar chart links, tool actions, icon registration, and color editing; Navbar slots and CSS parts; Navigation Drawer items, positioning, and mini variants.
Display and customize banners, snackbars, toasts, and dialogs with messages, icons, actions, forms, dismissal behavior, timing, event handling, and styling
Configure calendars and date pickers for date selection, localization, formatting, validation, disabled and special dates, ranges, forms, slots, styling.
Covers theme loading with CSS variables or Sass, palette generation and scopes, elevations, typography, component styles, accessibility, and token utilities
